entries.notes: Cards show title with expandable details (tags, metadata, actions). Web opens the Hydrus client file URL with the access key.
System predicate filters: filetype (image/video/audio/animation/pdf/archive) and inbox/archive.
Web button opens the file in the browser. Proxy now uses Hydrus session keys so the access key is sent only once and never appears in URLs.
Cards show the title tag and include a Download button for the original file.
Freeform * search returns all files (system:everything). Typed search is used as-is instead of being ANDed onto the category.
Admin settings are only Allow search plus category name and search query. Connection stays on the API.
Admin allowSearch option shows a freeform tag search bar for any Hydrus query.
Admin-configurable categories as Hydrus tag search prompts, with in-plugin filtering.
Initial Hydrus Network API plugin: connection test and client status.
